## FrameSource  (type-only)
interface FrameSource {
    requestFrame(cb: (timeMs: number) => void): number;
    cancelFrame(handle: number): void;
}

## HapticImpact  (type-only)
type HapticImpact = 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy';

## HapticNotification  (type-only)
type HapticNotification = 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

## Host  (type-only)
interface Host extends FrameSource {
    readonly kind: HostKind;
    readonly embed: EmbedContext;
    openExternal(url: string, opts: {
        activation: LinkActivation;
    }): OpenResult;
    copyText(text: string): Promise<CopyResult>;
    clipboardWriteAllowed(): boolean;
    readonly fullscreen: HostFullscreen;
    readonly storage: HostStorage;
    readonly window?: HostWindow;
    readonly lifecycle?: HostLifecycle;
    readonly haptics?: HostHaptics;
    readonly safeArea?: HostSafeArea;
}

## HostFullscreen  (type-only)
interface HostFullscreen {
    available(): boolean;
    readonly active: boolean;
    toggle(opts?: {
        lockLandscape?: boolean;
    }): Promise<boolean>;
    watch(fn: (on: boolean) => void): () => void;
}

## HostHaptics  (type-only)
interface HostHaptics {
    available(): boolean;
    impact(style: HapticImpact): void;
    notification(kind: HapticNotification): void;
    vibrate(ms: number): void;
}

## HostInsets  (type-only)
interface HostInsets {
    top: number;
    right: number;
    bottom: number;
    left: number;
}

## HostKind  (type-only)
type HostKind = 'web' | 'electron' | 'xr' | 'capacitor';

## HostLifecycle  (type-only)
interface HostLifecycle {
    readonly state: HostLifecycleState;
    watch(fn: (state: HostLifecycleState) => void): () => void;
}

## HostLifecycleState  (type-only)
type HostLifecycleState = 'active' | 'background';

## HostSafeArea  (type-only)
interface HostSafeArea {
    insets(): Readonly<HostInsets>;
    watch(fn: (insets: Readonly<HostInsets>) => void): () => void;
}

## HostStorage  (type-only)
interface HostStorage {
    readonly kind: string;
    open(): StorageLike | null;
}

## HostWindow  (type-only)
interface HostWindow {
    close(): void;
    minimize?(): void;
    toggleMaximize?(): void;
    setTitle?(title: string): void;
}

## WebHostOptions  (type-only)
interface WebHostOptions {
    win?: Window;
}

## XrHost  (type-only)
interface XrHost extends Host {
    readonly kind: 'xr';
    readonly session: XRSession;
    readonly base: Host;
    readonly frame: XRFrame | null;
}
